value_narrative: Replaces ad-hoc per-read context loading with a single deterministic command: gz context <ADR-ID> renders the ADR body, every OBPI brief under it, the covering-test paths grouped by REQ, and a governance-rules section as one ANSI-free Markdown payload pipeable verbatim to any agent harness. Move 2 of the get-out-of-jail recovery plan.
key_proof: Smoke run: `uv run gz context ADR-0.0.3-hexagonal-architecture-tune-up | wc -c` emits ~84.7 KB Markdown to stdout. Error path: `uv run gz context ADR-9.9.9-does-not-exist; echo "exit=$?"` emits `BLOCKERS: gz context: error: ADR not found: ADR-9.9.9-does-not-exist` and exits 1.
